methods.note: The extraction describes a 3D steady implicit CFD model with realizable k-epsilon. Table 2 (PDF p.3) also lists the solver type as 'Steady, Axisymmetric, Implicit', which contradicts the 3D claim and is not reported in the extraction. Sec. 2.1 (PDF p.6) lists 'laminar flow' among the assumptions while the model is realizable k-epsilon (turbulent), so the physics is internally contradictory. The extraction also asserts that the Table 5 Rosli case is 'different' from the Table 6 case. The paper says the Rosli comparison uses the same 6x6, 0.4 cm gap layout, yet the temperatures differ by about 20 C (106.47 vs 126.97 C), so that explanation is an unsupported inference. The extraction correctly states that no optimizer or controller exists and that the setup is a 3D forced-air conjugate model, so it cannot be a 2D reproduction.

code.note: No code, Icepak project, repository or supplementary files are linked. The Data availability statement says 'No data was used' (PDF p.11), and the packet assets list is empty. Nothing could be inspected, and the extraction correctly records this.

parameters.note: The transcribed values match the pdftotext of Table 1, Table 3 and Table 6: chip 2.2x2.2x0.1 cm, cabinet 6x5x2 cm, 36 fins, 8 W, 0.1 m/s, 298 K and 126.97 C. They do not resolve the paper's own conflicts. Table 1 gives a 4x4x1.7 cm heat sink and a 0.2 cm fin diameter, while the text (PDF p.5) gives a 3x3.5x2 cm base, 1.5 cm fins and a 0.16 cm radius. The Fig. 9 text shows about 295 K at the inlet against Tin = 298 K. Table 7 pressure drop has no units. The 8 W heat location (chip vs heat sink bottom wall) is ambiguous. The geometry is therefore not usable as a single consistent parameter set.

config.note: There is no machine-readable configuration. The experiment has an empty floorplan and empty power_w. No block placement coordinates exist, and Fig. 1 is a schematic that was not visually verified. Substrate, solid material properties, and the fin spacing and positions for the 6x6 inline layout are not given. Studio package and material assumptions are unspecified. Generated 2D shelf coordinates would be illustrative only.

data.note: The only data are scalar values in Tables 5-7. The reported observable (126.97 C, Table 6, PDF p.11) is text-verified only. The decisive figures (Fig. 1, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12) were not rendered or visually checked, because only pdftotext output was supplied. No same-scenario per-block power table exists, since only a single 8 W for one chip is given. There is no transient trace, and no pinned assets or digitized data.

findings.reason: The extraction says the Table 5 values (106.474 C IA) belong to 'a different, Rosli-comparison case'. The paper says the comparison uses the same six-row, six-column design with a 0.4 cm gap, so it is unexplained why the same IA circular case gives 106.474 C in Table 5 and 126.97 C in Table 6. This is a possible internal contradiction in the paper's observable, and the extraction's explanation is unsupported.
